description: Defines the AlarmAssignmentNotificationInfo class, which encapsulates notification details related to alarm assignments in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AlarmAssignmentNotificationInfo
classes.description: Notification info class for alarm assignment events, implementing RuleOriginatedNotificationInfo interface.

methods.name: getTemplateData
methods.description: Generates a map of template data for notification emails or messages.

methods.name: getAffectedCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID affected by the alarm assignment.

methods.name: getAffectedUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID of the assignee.

methods.name: getStateEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID of the alarm originator.

methods.name: getDashboardId
methods.description: Returns the dashboard ID associated with the alarm.
